concerns.text: FR-002 (docstring generation) and FR-003 (coverage scoring) lack a verified implementation path. T024 (generation loop), T026 (aggregation), and T033 (coverage calculation) are marked as unchecked [ ] in the tasks file, meaning the core experimental pipeline is not fully covered by executable tasks.

FR-001 requires extracting data from the 'top 20 PyPI repositories', but T010 (repo list creation) is marked as unchecked [ ]. Without this task being defined as complete or having a corresponding task to generate/fetch the list, the foundational dataset for the study is missing a covering task.

The spec edge case requiring empty/whitespace docstrings to be flagged (coverage_score=0.0, needs_review=true) has no covering task. T027 is marked as unchecked [ ] and is the only task addressing this specific edge case defined in the spec.

SC-003 (semantic similarity) and SC-001 (statistical significance) lack required verification steps. T030 (unit test for semantic similarity) and T031 (unit test for Wilcoxon test) are marked as unchecked [ ], leaving these success criteria without a defined testing task.

The project structure required by the Constitution (Principle III: Data Hygiene) and Plan is unverified. T001 (Create project structure) is marked as unchecked [ ], meaning the foundational directory structure task is not covered as complete.

T011b defines `MemoryLimitException` but lacks a `[US#]` or `[FR-NNN]` tag. While the description links it to T025, explicit tagging is required for robust traceability to the spec's error handling requirements.
